stem:
A student investigates a circuit containing capacitors. The circuit is connected with a capacitor of capacitance *A*, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

Two capacitors, each of capacitance *C*, are connected in parallel between P and Q.

Initially, switch X and switch Z are closed and switch Y is open.

Switches X and Z are opened. Switch Y is then closed. The maximum potential difference between P and Q is measured using the voltmeter. This procedure is repeated and the mean maximum potential difference *V* between P and Q is determined.

The experiment is then repeated by changing the number *n* of capacitors, each of capacitance *C*, connected in parallel between P and Q.

It is suggested that *V* and *n* are related by the equation

*EA* = *V*(*nC* + *A*)

where *E* is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of the battery.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted with $\frac{1}{V}$ on the y-axis against *n* on the x-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and y-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *n* and the two measured values of the maximum potential difference *V*₁ and *V*₂ are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of *V* / V and $\frac{1}{V}$ / V⁻¹ in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in *V* and $\frac{1}{V}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Plot a graph of $\frac{1}{V}$ / V⁻¹ against *n*. Include error bars for $\frac{1}{V}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the y-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *E* and *C*. Include appropriate units.

Data: *A* = (2.2 ± 0.2) mF

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the percentage uncertainty in your value of *C*.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated with 10 capacitors, each of capacitance *C*, connected in parallel between P and Q. Determine the maximum potential difference *V* between P and Q.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A circuit diagram shows a battery and switch X, a capacitor of capacitance A, two capacitors in parallel between P and Q, switch Y, a voltmeter, and switch Z.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table lists n values from 2 to 7 and measured values V₁ and V₂, with empty columns for V and 1/V.
A blank graph grid has n on the horizontal axis from 1 to 8 and 1/V on the vertical axis from 0.22 to 0.44 V⁻¹.
